description: This file defines the 'Footer' class in the Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Common namespace, responsible for rendering the footer part of the Opencart catalog pages. It loads language, models, and data needed for the footer view, including links to various pages, information, and online user tracking.

classes.name: Footer
classes.description: Controller class for rendering the website footer, extending the system's Controller class, loading necessary data and rendering the footer view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares data for the footer view, including information links, customer online tracking, and scripts, then returns the rendered footer view.
